PreToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(git commit|gh pr create)'; then echo '[Hook] Remember to include Slack thread URL in commit/PR'; fi

PostToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'gh pr create'; then echo '[Hook] Verify Slack thread link is in PR body'; fi

SessionStart.command: echo '=== OpenClaw Workspace ===' && echo 'Level 5: Self-Improving Meta-Systems' && echo '' && echo 'Available skills: /slack-to-pr, /standup, /audit-setup, /run-experiment' && echo 'Priority stack: video-ingestor > slack-to-pr > standup > audit-setup' && echo '' && if [ -f .learnings/EXPERIMENTS.md ]; then echo "Experiments logged: $(grep -c '^## ' .learnings/EXPERIMENTS.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"; fi
